description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for pack performance in a git repository, utilizing functions from an external script, 'perf-lib.sh'. It defines various testing functions, creates test input data, and runs multiple git pack-objects commands with different parameters to evaluate performance and size.

methods.name: test_all_with_args
methods.description: Runs a series of performance and size tests on git pack-objects commands with a specified parameter.
